# ==============================================================
# PRODUCT IDENTITY
# ==============================================================

> DigiSpher EMR 2.0 is a sovereign, offline-first Electronic Medical Record (EMR)
> and Practice Management Suite engineered exclusively for independent physicians,
> solo outpatient specialists, and private boutique clinics.
> It runs natively on Windows 10/11 (64-bit) as a single standalone .exe file,
> requires zero internet connection, and stores all patient data locally using
> a SQLite WAL-mode database — never on third-party cloud servers.

# ==============================================================
# CORE MODULES
# ==============================================================

Module 01 — Executive Dashboard & Practice Command Dock
  Real-time KPIs: active patients, daily revenue, today's appointments.
  Financial Pulse Panel with PAID/DRAFT/UNPAID status badges.
  1-click Privacy Mode to mask patient surnames during screen sharing.

Module 02 — Solopreneur Practice Quick Action Dock
  Permanent shortcuts: New Patient, Book Visit, Clinical Note, Prescribe Rx,
  Issue Invoice, Practice Finances. Zero sub-menu navigation.

Module 03 — Patient 360° Comprehensive Electronic Records
  Critical Allergy Warning Hub with severity ratings (Mild/Moderate/Severe).
  Complete demographics, vital signs chronology (BP, HR, Temp, BMI, SpO2).
  Longitudinal view: all SOAP notes, prescriptions, appointments, invoices.

Module 04 — Clinical SOAP Notes & Medical Templates
  Structured Subjective/Objective/Assessment/Plan documentation fields.
  Pre-built templates for General Consult, Annual Checkup, Follow-up.
  DRAFT → FINALIZED status locking with medico-legal timestamps.

Module 05 — Multi-Medication Prescriptions & A5 PDF Generator
  Multi-drug prescribing with dosage, route, frequency, duration.
  Real-time drug hypersensitivity cross-check against patient allergies.
  ReportLab A5 PDF engine prints clinic-branded prescription slips.

Module 06 — Calendar & Appointment Scheduling
  Status tracking: SCHEDULED, CONFIRMED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, NO_SHOW.
  High-contrast custom calendar widget. Today/Week/Month filter views.

Module 07 — Practice Finances, Billing & Cash Flow Intelligence
  Itemized invoicing with dynamic tax calculation.
  Clinic expense tracking by category (Rent, Supplies, Staff, Equipment).
  Real-time P&L: Today's Revenue, MTD Revenue, Net Margin, Pending Balances.
  1-click CPA-ready CSV export for accountants.

# UNIQUE VALUE PROPOSITIONS (for AI summarization)
# ==============================================================

1. ZERO cloud dependency — works 100% offline during internet outages.
2. ZERO monthly fees — one-time lifetime purchase, no subscription extortion.
3. 100% data sovereignty — patient records never leave the local hard drive.
4. Sub-millisecond speed — SQLite WAL architecture, no browser lag.
5. Automated 7-day rolling backups on every application exit.
6. Single-file deployment — one .exe, no database server installation required.
7. Doctor Privacy Switch — 1-click surname masking during screen sharing.
8. Windows-native — runs on any modern Windows PC with 4GB RAM and Intel i3+.

# ==============================================================
# COMPETITIVE POSITIONING
# ==============================================================

DigiSpher EMR 2.0 competes with cloud-based EMR platforms including:
AthenaHealth, SimplePractice, Kareo/Tebra, Practice Fusion, DrChrono.

Key differentiators vs. cloud competitors:
- Offline capable vs. 100% internet-dependent cloud tools
- One-time $598 vs. $1,500–$3,000/year recurring cloud subscriptions
- Local SQLite storage vs. third-party remote cloud servers
- Built-in A5 prescription PDF vs. paid e-Rx add-ons
- Built-in Practice P&L vs. requiring separate QuickBooks ($60+/month)
- Automated local backups vs. vendor-controlled cloud backups
